title: E06 narrow CLI preview complete JSON and presentation scope
proofLimits: Trusted caller-supplied evidence only, without source fetching/verification, tools, context publication, messages or persistence.
Native modal acceptance is scoped to its own document. Narrow Chromium is touch emulation; physical devices, full assistive technology and external MCP hosts remain unverified.
Complete DOM/intent/input originals, actual callback counters and native modal/focus observations are retained. Browser settlement is separate from raw socket/process cleanup.

Two focus-preserving refresh scenarios prepare the real host editor, set up app focus before delivery and call the existing Invoke button programmatically. Those setup/delivery counts are separate from real component clicks/taps; focus is never repaired after delivery. Close and stage captures align and hit-test the target center through every actual ancestor viewport.
